cups.name: Cups
cups.lack: emotions and relationships have received little attention

swords.name: Swords
swords.lack: clarity and a sober assessment are lacking

pentacles.name: Pentacles
pentacles.lack: solid ground has not been established yet

majors.none: There are no Major Arcana — the situation is down to earth and depends largely on your own decisions.
majors.many: There are many Major Arcana ({n} of {total}) — this is a fateful matter: circumstances and lessons shape events more strongly than ordinary choices.
majors.one: One Major Arcana — {card}: this is the main theme of the spread and deserves special attention.
majors.some: {n} of {total} cards are Major Arcana — the situation has important turning points, but much remains within your power.

suit.dominant: {suit} dominate ({n}) — the theme of the spread: {theme}.
suit.tie: Several suits are equally strong: {suits} — areas of life are closely intertwined.

reversed.none: All cards are upright — energy flows freely and the situation itself holds few obstacles.
reversed.many: Many cards are reversed ({n} of {total}) — expect delays, inner doubt, or something that has not surfaced yet. Do not rush events.
reversed.few: Almost all cards are upright ({n} reversed) — the way is generally open, and the reversed cards mark where to be more careful.
reversed.mixed: Reversed cards: {n} of {total} — clear and hidden, not yet revealed sides of the situation are mixed.

courts.many: {n} court cards ({cards}) — people, their characters and intentions play a noticeable role.
courts.one: {card} — a specific person, or your own role, is involved in the situation.

aces.many: Aces — a sign of a new beginning and an opportunity worth noticing.
aces.one: {card} — a sign of a new beginning and an opportunity worth noticing.

tens.many: Tens — one of the cycles is coming to an end.
tens.one: {card} — one of the cycles is coming to an end.

open: The way is open — do not postpone what has ripened.
Conditions are favorable: it is time to move from thinking to doing.
The situation itself holds few obstacles — you can move ahead with confidence.
slow: It is better to slow down and listen to yourself now: haste will only add to the confusion.
Do not force events — much has not surfaced yet, and hurry is a poor adviser.
Give the situation time to ripen and avoid hasty decisions.
mixed: Move forward, but check the details — part of the picture is still hidden.
Part of the path is clear, part is in fog: act where you can see and clarify the rest as you go.
Go step by step and check each next step.

wands: Direct your strength into one main task rather than several at once.
You have enough energy — the key is not to scatter it and to choose a priority.
Show initiative, but do not flare up: fire is for the work, not for arguments.
cups: Trust your feelings and speak about them openly — that is where the key lies.
Listen to your heart and to the mood of those close to you: the answer lies in relationships.
Do not hide your emotions — an honest conversation matters more than any calculation right now.
swords: Before deciding, clarify the facts and call things by their names.
Think soberly and do not let anxious thoughts make decisions for you.
Important words and agreements are best stated clearly and, where possible, put in writing.
pentacles: Rely on concrete steps and verifiable results.
Bet on practice: money, time, health — whatever can be measured.
Build a reliable plan and follow it without haste.
majors: The question is bigger than you — accept what happens as a lesson and do not push events.
This is a turning point: look at the situation more broadly than just today.
Some circumstances are beyond your control — focus on what you can choose.
balanced: No single area outweighs the others — keep the whole picture in view and do not fixate on one card.
The spread is well-rounded: do not single out the main thing too early, check every side of the question.
Your forces are evenly spread — act steadily and avoid extremes.

outcome_up: The final card supports you — treat it as your goal.
The outcome of the spread is favorable: keep your course.
outcome_rev: The outcome is not yet settled: what can change it lies in your own behavior now.
The final card is a warning — recheck your plan while there is time.
obstacle_rev: The main obstacle is inside: start with an honest talk with yourself.
obstacle_up: The obstacle is real, so prepare a fallback option in advance.
nuance.conflict: When impulse and feelings, or ideas and practicality, pull in different directions, choose one line and hold to it consistently.
nuance.harmony: Lean on the harmony of the elements in the spread: what you have in mind is supported by circumstances.
nuance.courts: Much depends on the people around you: state your boundaries and expectations clearly.
nuance.aces: Notice the opportunity at the very beginning — it will not come again in the same form.
nuance.tens: Do not fear endings: a closed cycle frees energy for the next one.

lack_suit.wands: Bring more initiative and genuine interest into the situation.
lack_suit.cups: Pay attention to feelings and relationships — they found no place in the spread.
lack_suit.swords: Check the facts: the spread lacks a sober assessment.
lack_suit.pentacles: Think about the practical side: deadlines, money, resources.

nuance.majors_many: Do not try to control everything: part of what is happening is a lesson, not a task.

lack.fire: determination and inner fire are missing
lack.air: clarity and a sober view are lacking

elements.dominant: The element of the spread is {el} ({n} of {total}): {theme}.

conflict.fire_water: Fire and Water clash — impulse and feelings pull in different directions; take care not to extinguish one with the other.
conflict.air_earth: Air and Earth diverge — ideas argue with practice: check whether your plan is feasible.

harmony.fire_air: Fire and Air strengthen each other — ideas easily turn into action.
harmony.water_earth: Water and Earth support each other — feelings find a reliable foundation.

elements.balanced: The cards belong to different elements ({list}) — the spread is well-rounded and no single area draws all the attention.
elements.tie: Elements {list} are equally represented — their forces balance one another.

pair.fire_earth: Fire and Earth — impulse meets practicality: energy takes shape and can become a result.
pair.water_air: Water and Air — feelings and reason speak different languages: it matters to put into words what you feel.

numerology.sum: The number of the spread is {sum}{via}: {meaning}.
numerology.via: (the card numbers add up to {raw}, reduced to {r})
numerology.repeat: The number {num} repeats ({k_cards}): {meaning} — this theme runs through the whole spread.

meanings.7: search for meaning, analysis, inner work
meanings.22: realizing a large undertaking, great building

advice.1: Do not wait for the perfect moment — the first step matters more than the plan.
advice.2: Weigh your choice calmly and do not decide alone if there is someone you can trust.
advice.3: Do not keep ideas to yourself: conversation and creativity help right now.
advice.4: Put things in order and build a solid foundation before moving on.
advice.5: Be ready for change and do not cling to the familiar.
advice.6: Look after those close to you and after fairness in relationships — harmony rests on responsibility.
advice.7: Give yourself time for silence and reflection: the answer will come from within.
advice.8: Act with confidence and answer for the result — you have the strength for it.
advice.9: Take stock and let go of what has served its purpose — it makes room for the new.
advice.11: Listen to your intuition, but do not let tension make decisions for you.
advice.22: The task is within reach if you break it into clear stages.

positions.arc: The spread runs from “{first}” ({card1}) to “{last}” ({card2}) — the main line of events passes between these cards.

roles.up: Outcome — {card}{kw}. Things develop in your favor if you keep your course.
roles.rev: Outcome — {card} (reversed){kw}, but in a hidden or distorted form. The result is not predetermined: much depends on your actions.

roles.up: Main obstacle — {card}{kw}. It is real, but understandable and surmountable.
roles.rev: Main obstacle — {card} (reversed){kw}. It is largely inner: doubt, fear or a postponed decision.

roles.up: Advice of the card — {card}{kw}. This is a direct pointer on how to act.
roles.rev: Advice of the card — {card} (reversed){kw}. More of a warning: what to avoid and where to slow down.

roles.up: Near future — {card}{kw}. Events are moving in exactly this direction.
roles.rev: Near future — {card} (reversed){kw}. The direction is hindered: delays or a change of plan are possible.

roles.up: Heart of the matter — {card}{kw}. This is the center of the spread — a place to start from.
roles.rev: Heart of the matter — {card} (reversed){kw}. The main theme is hidden or blocked for now — look at it more closely.

roles.up: Roots of the situation — {card}{kw}. Past experience works in your favor.
roles.rev: Roots of the situation — {card} (reversed){kw}. Something unresolved remains in the past and echoes today.

roles.up: Inner state — {card}{kw}. Your expectations and feelings are in tune with the situation.
roles.rev: Inner state — {card} (reversed){kw}. Hopes and fears are mixed up: what you fear may not be the main thing.

roles.up: Goal — {card}{kw}. This is what your mind truly reaches for.
roles.rev: Goal — {card} (reversed){kw}. The goal is vague or needs to be reconsidered.

roles.up: Environment and outside influences — {card}{kw}. Circumstances and people tend to support you.
roles.rev: Environment and outside influences — {card} (reversed){kw}. Other people’s intentions or circumstances may not match your expectations.

choice.title: Comparing the Options

opt.good: {pos} — {card}{kw}. This path works in your favor.
opt.mixed: {pos} — {card}{kw}. The outcome is mixed: there will be both gains and risks.
opt.hard: {pos} — {card}{kw}. This path is not easy: it will take effort and caution.

choice.major: {card} is a Major Arcana: this option carries special weight and is no accident.

verdict.win: “{win}” looks stronger than “{lose}”: the cards speak in its favor.
verdict.tie_good: Both options are favorable — choose the one your heart leans toward.
verdict.tie_hard: Neither path is easy — consider whether there is a third option, or do not rush the decision.
verdict.tie_mixed: The options are roughly equal in strength — your values and preferences decide.

advice.win: If you must choose, take “{win}” — but check its weak points first.
advice.tie_good: Do not be afraid of making a mistake: either path will open good opportunities.
advice.tie_hard: Do not decide under pressure: give yourself time and gather more information.
advice.tie_mixed: Write down the pros and cons of each option and check them against your intuition.

week.best: The most favorable day is {day} ({card}{kw}). It is best to place what matters on it.
week.hard: The most difficult day is {day} ({card}{kw}). Allow extra time and energy.
week.rising: The week gains strength: the second half goes better than the first.
week.falling: Energy fades toward the end of the week: it is better to do important things early on.
week.even: The week runs evenly, without sharp swings.
